name: Class buffs: Banner of Conquest and Horn of War are support crit buffs that replace each other
contract: Class reviewer feedback 2026-11-22 (PR #13237): Horn of War, Focal Point, Fleshbending, Frozen Blades,
Banner of Conquest and Infused With Power are the 5% crit buffs of the support specs and keep one at a time.
Banner of Conquest 500264 (Guardian, class 18) is a 20 second raid area aura, SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT base
points 4: +5%, that the endless Banner of Conquest 500261 pulses; 500261's tooltip says it does not stack
with similar effects, and the generator lists 500264 as a support buff, so spell_group 2113005 (rule 1,
SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE) holds it beside Horn of War 800086 (Ranger, class 21, 30 seconds, +5%).
Expected: on a grouped ally Horn of War replaces the Banner of Conquest aura, and the banner's area updates
do not put it back while Horn of War lasts.

steps.label: The Guardian attaches the Banner of Conquest
SETUP: the Banner of Conquest aura reaches the ally
The Ranger sounds Horn of War
SETUP: Horn of War reaches the ally
Give the banner's area aura updates time to try the ally again
DISCRIMINATING: support crit buffs keep one, so Horn of War replaced the Banner of Conquest aura
DISCRIMINATING: the banner does not push Horn of War off the ally
